consolidationRisk.explanation: Measures short-term market extension and pullback/consolidation risk, not Nasdaq direction. The score blends QQQ and SOX stretch, breadth, volatility and, when enough history is available, multi-day returns, moving-average extension and RSI. Model coverage shows how much of the full 100-point model currently has usable data.
consolidationRisk.note: Short-term extension risk, not a directional Nasdaq forecast. Historical components unlock as NasBoard history grows.
